contract.declaration: Each read/preview business tool loaded by Main Agent is declared relevant for this request.
contract.requiredRelevantTools: Runtime tracks every declared read/preview business tool.
contract.completionGate: A no-tool response is resumed with RELEVANT_API_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE until every declared relevant tool has executed or formally failed.
contract.lateDiscovery: A later load_tools call can declare additional relevant tools.
contract.duplicateProtection: Existing successful-call duplicate protection remains active.
contract.writeBoundary: Write tools never enter the read/preview coverage set.

semanticFinding: The mechanical gate achieved declared coverage but did not prevent Main Agent from declaring unrelated tools relevant in all natural-language cases.
